summary: Klarna Group plc filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, announcing it will serve as the leasing provider for Apple Upgrade, a new hardware leasing program from Apple Inc. in the United States. The filing includes a press release and a note to investors. No financial terms, stake, or price were disclosed. This is a routine business partnership announcement, not a special situation. The registrant is Klarna as the filer. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are mentioned. What to watch: This is a commercial agreement, not a transaction requiring M&A analysis.
